intro: I’m Sean, a passionate restoration technician. I use all available tools in my arsenal to come up with unique solutions to tough problems.

disciplines.name: Mechanical Restoration
disciplines.description: Teardown, inspection and rebuild of worn assemblies. Precision measurement of critical components, replacement or recondition of worn parts and accomplishment of working assemblies.

disciplines.name: Fabrication
disciplines.description: Metalwork tailored to the job: fabrication solutions using modern tools and techniques, fit up, and welding processes to provide a strong and well thought out product.

disciplines.name: 3D Modeling
disciplines.description: CAD models of the parts that have to be replaced, adapted or made from scratch. Use of 3D scanning, modeling and printing. Producing tools custom fit to the job.

facts.label: Looking for
facts.value: Restoration work and problems in need of creative solutions
